ui.effect.dcOffset.desc: Corrects a waveform whose center is shifted from 0.
ui.effect.fade.desc: Smooths the beginning and end of a whole side.
ui.effect.gain.desc: Raises or lowers the volume, either by a value you set or by peak normalization (automatically matching the highest peak to a target level).
ui.effect.parametricEq.desc: Boosts or cuts the sound around the chosen frequency.
ui.effect.rumble.desc: Cuts low or high sounds at the specified frequency.
ui.effect.rumble.desc.highPass: Cuts sounds below the specified frequency, removing barely audible very low-frequency vibration and the like.
ui.effect.rumble.desc.lowPass: Cuts sounds above the specified frequency, softening harsh high-frequency noise.
ui.eq.paramTip.filterType: Peaking: raises or lowers a hill-shaped band around the frequency. Low shelf: raises or lowers everything below the frequency. High shelf: raises or lowers everything above the frequency.
ui.eq.paramTip.freqHz: The center frequency of the effect. For shelves, the boundary frequency.
ui.eq.paramTip.gainDb: The amount of boost or cut. Positive values boost; negative values cut.
ui.eq.paramTip.q: The width of the effect. The larger the value, the narrower the range affected.
ui.eq.rumble.slopeNote: Setting the slope to 36 dB/oct or more makes the phase change significantly.
